bayts.text: A Guardian, Subduer — exalted be He — Preventer, has protected me from all harm, and good today obeys me.
The Subduer protected me from all the enemies, and their lances and cannons betrayed them.
To Him — exalted be He — all of me, and He is my Lord and my Guardian: through Him trial and calamities are repelled from me.
His slave I have become, and the Followed (al-Muqaffā) is my means of access, and his Companions, lions against the enemies, I match.
He is Allah Who protects me and protects all that He chose for me in the two Abodes; and Allah is All-Embracing.
He protects me from harm by grace and gives me the wishes; through Him the severing things are perpetually repelled from me.
All-Knowing, Wise, He has already protected me with wisdom, and spares my side the evil of what befalls.
Blessing and peace from Allah I seek for him who was a slave hastening in acts of obedience,
Muḥammad, who perpetually saves his servant, with the Family and the Companions: what an excellent obedient one!
A noble one, through whom I hope from Allah for protection and the well-being of the two Abodes; and Allah is Beneficent.
From Allah, Lord of humankind, I hope for happiness, and that He accept the deeds; and Allah is the Raiser.
My salvation, saving (others) and attaining steadfastness I seek through Allah, and the heart is content.
To Allah, with the Qurʾān and the Sunna that guided me, I have turned everything, and the heart is humble.
His have I become, through the Qurʾān, a slave, the servant of him to whom my service goes in longing, and he is an intercessor.
The Prophet of guidance, sea of bounty, lion against the enemies, he whose bounty repels poverty and whose sword cuts.
To the Chosen, the best of creatures, Muḥammad, (be) the blessing of Allah, Who is the Gatherer.
Peace upon the Effacer, with the Messengers and the (heavenly) assembly, from the One, the Subduer, the Preventer.
